name: peak-mods
description: A bundle of Claude Code mods (hooks-module plugins). Includes file-tree: an Explorer-style pane over the working directory with a read-only file viewer (/files).

enableFileTree.title: Enable file-tree
enableFileTree.description: Turns on the file-tree mod and its /files command.

fileTreeAutoOpen.title: file-tree: open at session start
fileTreeAutoOpen.description: Opens the Files pane when a session starts, where the terminal is wide enough to dock it as a sidebar.

fileTreeIgnore.title: file-tree: hidden names
fileTreeIgnore.description: Comma-separated file and folder names the tree hides.
